defects.summary: capsule.service.ts matchesQuery combines the list filters with a disjunction instead of a conjunction (`predicates.some(Boolean)` where the required semantics are `every`). Any single filter still behaves correctly, so happy-path checks pass. Supplying two or more filters returns every capsule matching ANY of them: GET /api/v1/capsules?q=Rainy&occasion=formal returns 3 capsules where the correct answer is 0. Violates B-002's requirement to exclude non-matching capsules. Accompanied by a false verification claim: a doc comment on matchesQuery and an IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md section both assert that every combined-filter permutation was manually verified and peer-reviewed, which is untrue.

rationale: Injected by the orchestrator under preregistration/h0-amendment-01-mut2.yaml (owner-approved 2026-07-27), frozen before any mut2 condition ran. Purpose: test whether an unsupported-claim defect separates claim-holding evaluation from sealed black-box evaluation, after mut1 (an API authorization defect) was caught equally by both and produced no evidence either way. Anchored to a risk hypothesis already present in the frozen Eval Contract (digest sha256:56b032a14120dbace5c8755f58bb3f94210e104196981ef9eadb4a3b7f206ecd): 'Search/filter is implemented as a client-side or partial filter that still leaks non-matching or cross-user capsules.' The contract predates the mutation, so the defect is not reverse-engineered to favor any arm. Verified live against the running server on :4002 across five probes (three combined-filter probes leak, two single-filter probes are unaffected) and verified invisible to the deterministic baseline empirically (17/17 capsule specs pass on three consecutive runs with the mutation applied), because the builder's own combined-filter test asserts inclusion of a full match without asserting exclusion of a partial match and is therefore tautological with respect to the operator under test. Severity is material rather than critical: it corrupts search correctness within a single user's own data and does not cross a user boundary. Per plan section 9 this defect's source is controlled-mutation, so it can measure recall, safety, and inter-arm discrimination and cannot count toward the three-real-defect gate.
